_description: Common frontmatter contract for every mission output file (missions/*/outputs/NN-slug.md) and every eval fixture. Frontmatter is flat 'key: value' lines between two '---' fences; no nesting, no YAML lists, so the runner parses it without a YAML library.

mission.why: Ties the output to its missions/ folder; 'fixture' for eval fixtures.

step.why: Selects which entry in steps.json governs this file.

owner.why: Must match the pipeline Owner column for the step (determinism rule: orchestration order lives in pipeline.md, not agent judgment).

date.why: Anchor for the 90-day source-freshness check. Absolute dates, never relative.

expect_fail.why: Broken fixtures only: names the single check this fixture must fail. The self-test fails CI if the named check passes.
